system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and mark the target with a drop of vitae, then spend one Blood Trait per level of Fortitude you wish to grant and win a Static Physical Challenge against three times the Blood Traits spent. Success bestows that many levels of Fortitude on the target for the rest of the night (only the net increase counts if they already have some); failure allows a Survival retest. Only one instance of this power may be active on a given target at a time.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait per level of Fortitude granted, per target
system.retestAbility: One Willpower Trait, plus Survival for retest
